property_summary: For any caller address X, calling setL1BlockValues must only succeed when msg.sender equals the depositorAccount stored in the contract; the mutant that checks msg.sender == address(this) will reject valid depositor callers (or allow none) and thus violate this invariant for some fuzzed depositor addresses.
change_summary: Replace require guard to allow only the contract deployer (owner) instead of depositorAccount, changing who can set the stored L1 block values.
